name: tool-agent-nested
about: agent 与配置里的 subagents 段：子代理用 agent.subagents.default 指定的模型，maxDepth 为 2 时 general-purpose 子代理自己还能再派一层 plan 子代理。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  subagents:
    default: bbx/helper
    maxDepth: 2
    timeoutMs: 120000
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        helper:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 32768
            maxOutputTokens: 4096
telemetry:
  enabled: false

provider.name: grandchild
when: You are a subagent of PilotDeck

reply.text:
Scope: planned.
Result: 1. step
Key files: none
Files changed: none
Issues: none

provider.name: child-after-tool
when: You are a subagent of PilotDeck

reply.text:
Scope: delegated.
Result: the plan is one step.
Key files: none
Files changed: none
Issues: none

provider.name: child
when: You are a subagent of PilotDeck

arguments.prompt: CHILD-L1: get a plan from a planner.
